notes.title: Pingers coming July 29th 2021
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442410/Pingers/

My new game Pingers will be releasing on July 29th! You can find out more about it on Steam above.

Pingers is an addictive 'one-more-round' score chaser which is perfect to play solo or with friends. Ping your way to victory and see just how far you can get!

If you want to chat to me about Pingers join our Discord: https://discord.gg/pnAn6WkDPp
